components.name: CTA Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action with gradient fill and glow border wrapper.
components.css: .ds-cta-border { padding: 2px; border-radius: 22px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6EE7B7 0%, #34D399 42%, #059669 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(110,231,183,0.25), 0 0 56px rgba(110,231,183,0.32), 0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); display: inline-block; } .ds-cta-btn { border-radius: 20px; padding: 14px 34px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #0A0E1A; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #6EE7B7 0%, #5EEAD4 45%, #34D399 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code container for CUDA/CroqTile snippets.
components.html: #include <cuda.h> __global__ void kernel() {}
components.css: .ds-code-block { background: #111827; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px 32px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.58; color: #A7F3D0; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-code-block code { white-space: pre; } .ds-code-kw { color: #6EE7B7; } .ds-code-str { color: #FCD34D; } .ds-code-comment { color: #818CF8; }

components.name: Section Tag
components.description: Dot + uppercase mono label identifying a scene section.
components.css: .ds-section-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-tag-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #6EE7B7; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-tag-text { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #6EE7B7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: GitHub Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped repository link badge used in outro CTA.
components.css: .ds-gh-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 9px 22px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(209,213,219,0.92); background: rgba(17,24,39,0.72); border: 1px solid rgba(110,231,183,0.14); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 28px rgba(110,231,183,0.06); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

narrative.overview:
CroqTile Videos treats every frame as a film shot composed inside a developer's terminal. The aesthetic is cinematic production quality applied to a developer-native dark interface: deep abyss backgrounds, mint-green accents that glow like phosphor traces, noise-textured surfaces that feel analog, and spring-physics animations timed to voiceover beats. The system rejects anything that looks like a slide deck, a stock-illustration explainer, or a gaming RGB showcase.

The bilingual presentation (Chinese and English) is structural, not cosmetic. Both languages share the same typographic hierarchy, the same timing, the same emphasis. Neither is a subtitle of the other.

Code is the protagonist. Real CUDA snippets and CroqTile kernel patterns occupy center frame, rendered in monospaced type at readable sizes, syntax-highlighted with the palette's semantic colors. Everything else exists to direct attention toward the code.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, noise-textured surfaces with glow-based depth
Mint/emerald green as the sole chromatic accent
Code blocks as hero visual elements
Cinematic pacing aligned to voiceover cues

rules.name: The Phosphor Rule
rules.body: Mint green appears on no more than 15% of any frame's surface area. Its impact comes from scarcity. A scene drenched in mint is a failed scene.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: #000000 is prohibited. The darkest value is Abyss Base (#0A0E1A), tinted toward blue. Pure black kills the noise texture and flattens depth.

rules.name: The Code Protagonist Rule
rules.body: In any scene that shows code, the code block's type size must be at least as large as the body text. Code is never subordinate to prose.

rules.name: The CJK Parity Rule
rules.body: Chinese and English headlines occupy the same visual weight. If the Chinese line is 60px, the English line is no smaller than 56px. Neither language is an afterthought.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from light emission (colored glow halos), not from dark shadows falling downward. The card shadow is the sole exception: it anchors, it doesn't elevate.

dos: Do use spring physics for all entrance animations. Default config: damping 13-14, stiffness 120-128, mass 0.78-0.8.
Do use the noise overlay on every scene.
Do start from the Abyss Base (#0A0E1A) background.
Do render real CUDA/CroqTile code in code blocks.
Do time animations to voiceover cue points.
Do give Chinese and English equal typographic weight and timing.
Do use the Inset Highlight on elevated surfaces for directional light.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS explainer aesthetics: stock illustrations, bouncy cartoon transitions, pastel gradients.
Don't use corporate keynote slide layouts: bullet-point lists, centered title slides with no visual substance.
Don't use gaming/RGB aesthetics: rainbow neon, particle explosions, chromatic aberration.
Don't use design-agency reel style that prioritizes form over code substance.
Don't use tutorial screencast conventions: webcam overlays, casual narration tone, screen-recording borders.
Don't use linear easing or CSS ease. All motion uses exponential ease-out or spring physics.
Don't use border-left/right accents thicker than 1px as decorative stripes.
Don't let mint green exceed 15% of any frame's surface area.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. Spring damping stays above 12.
